verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS platform that holds customer compliance data and ships an AI feature (Compliance Navigator AI), so asking about a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
